positions.title: Intern I Technical

honors.title: 2011 Volunteer of the Year for the FIRST Lego League Peninsula District

volunteerExperiences.description: Coached and mentored robotics teams at Monta Vista High School and Woodside Priory to design, build, and program 5-foot 120-pound robots over 6-weeks for the annual FIRST Robotics Competition.  Taught the students computer-aided design programs and manufacturing skills, including wood shop and metal shop. Advised and assisted the teams with award submissions, game strategy, budget management, travel logistics, and other administrative tasks.

Tournament organizer for two 12-team FIRST Lego League tournaments. Handled all logistical issues including communicating with teams and organizing food for volunteers. Recruited 30+ volunteers for each tournament and ensured volunteers were properly trained
